title: validate-json-schema rejects the LinkRef x-substrate-theory annotation
description: The Root/fleet workflow instance initially validated through Vaporize. After the live LinkRef v0.0.5 schema gained x-substrate-theory, the same instance revalidation stopped at /beadTrackingRefs/0 with unsupported schema feature. x-substrate-theory is substrate metadata, not an assertion keyword. Vaporize needs an explicit annotation-extension policy that preserves loud refusal for unknown behavioral constraints while allowing declared non-assertive x- annotations.
acceptanceCriteria: A schema containing the declared x-substrate-theory annotation validates instances without treating the annotation as an unsupported assertion.
Vaporize preserves the annotation in diagnostics or schema provenance when useful but does not let it change the validation verdict.
A counterexample with a genuinely unsupported assertion keyword still refuses loudly.
The Root/fleet workflow instance validates against role-workflow-schemas v0.0.8 and the current LinkRef v0.0.5 schema.
Tests distinguish supported custom annotations from unsupported validation behavior.

relatedTypedRecords.t: Root and fleet sync-context capture instance
